title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
summary: As Scott Lang balances being both a superhero and a father, Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym present an urgent new mission that finds the Ant-Man fighting alongside The Wasp to uncover secrets from their past. (source: IMDb)

reception.actors: Paul Rudd, Evangeline Lilly, Michael Peña, Walton Goggins, Michael Douglas
